_comment: R2: the TS xApp decides from the stub QP's fixed predictions, R0 radio config (RngRun 1, outageThreshold -1000): IMSIs 1,2 start on cell 3 (gNB 3), IMSIs 3-6 on cell 2 (gNB 2). Each trigger is one 30003 naming one UE by its KPM UE ID key (en-gNB-UEID, enGnbUeId:<X2AP ID>@00F110-<MN cell>), resolved from the IMSI at the trigger's step and confirmed in Influx; one trigger per step; each IMSI is used in one step only. predictions = the stub's answer, serving cell first, unsigned integers [dl, ul], never a tie. The TS xApp hands over when the best cell's dl exceeds serving dl x (1 + threshold/100); it addresses the control to the UE's source en-gNB (SN-initiated, E2SM-RC Style 5 action 3), so via = the UE's serving gNB. Negatives: n1 the serving cell is best; n2 a neighbour 5 % above the serving cell, under the 10 % threshold (with threshold 0 it would hand over, so n2 proves the A1 policy took effect); n3 a well-formed key that no UE holds (X2AP ID 4095 on MN cell 1), with predictions that would hand over: the TS xApp reads the UE ID from Influx when it builds the control, finds no row and sends none. The threshold is rung-config.json a1_threshold.

calibration._comment: W calibration in the gated per-step shape (one trigger per step, the same agents): count positive triggers from firstStep every everySteps steps, IMSIs round robin 1..6, each sent to the cell it is not on (start cells below, flipped after each trigger), predictions serving [100, 0] then target [300, 0]. The calibration gate runs every per-run check (wire, stub, ledger counts, C9 handover rows, restart counts) as well as L and the one-control-per-trigger count; the same IMSI repeats the same source and target here, which the C9 window per applied line accounts for.
